decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the photographs submitted named Existing and proposed utility room door photograph, Existing and proposed rear door photograph, Existing and proposed front door photograph, Existing and proposed bed 4 door photograph, Existing and proposed vents, Existing and proposed bed 1 door photograph and drawing, Email from agent with supporting information received on the 9th May 2011 and drawings of the Proposed dining and bed 3 door drawing, Proposed utility window drawing, Proposed study and bed 1 window drawing, Proposed bed 2 window drawing, Proposed bed 3 window drawing, Proposed kitchen door drawing, Proposed lounge door drawing, Email from the agent with supporting information received 10th May 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: The replacement of the existing windows and doors under the BAA noise reduction scheme and the inclusion of ventilation units
